remarks: STAMFORD COMMUTER GEM! Welcome to Second Fairlawn, in desirable Glenbrook, where convenience meets comfortable, low-maintenance living. This first floor, 575-square-foot, 1-bedroom, 1-bath condominium features hardwood floors, large closets offering generous storage, and a kitchen with granite countertops, refrigerator, and gas range. This unit also includes one assigned parking space with plenty of visitor parking.  This pet-friendly community offers additional conveniences including an on-site common laundry area, secure in unit assigned lower level storage, and a park/playground area. The location alone is standout-just minutes from I-95, Route 15, and the train station, providing convenient access to major roadways, bus, and rail service.  Whether you're looking for a place to call home or an opportunity to own in Stamford, this home combines location, convenience, storage, and low-maintenance living in one attractive package. Schedule your showing today!
